description_en: Queries the delivery trace of a message. If a message is not sent or received as expected, you can call this operation to view the details about the message. For example, you can query the clients that subscribe to the message and the time when the message is delivered. This operation helps you locate the problem and identify the cause of the problem
description_zh: 查询指定消息的投递轨迹。当消息的收发不符合预期时，您可以通过该接口查看订阅该消息的客户端、消息的投递时间等详细信息，帮助您快速定位异常原因
kebab_example: aliyun onsmqtt query-mqtt-trace-message-subscribe --mqtt-region-id cn-hangzhou --instance-id mqtt-cn-i7m26mf0000 --begin-time 1621936800000 --end-time 1618646400000 --current-page 1 --page-size 5 --msg-id AC1EC1B33D5978308DB17F3245E40000 --api-version 2020-04-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: QueryMqttTraceMessageSubscribe

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region where the ApsaraMQ for MQTT instance resides. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181438.html
parameters.help_zh: 云消息队列 MQTT 版实例地域（Region）的ID。请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181438.html
parameters.name: mqtt_region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the ApsaraMQ for MQTT instance. The ID must be consistent with the ID of the instance that the ApsaraMQ for MQTT client uses. You can view the instance ID in the Basic Information section of the Instance Details page that corresponds to the instance in the ApsaraMQ for MQTT console
parameters.help_zh: 云消息队列 MQTT 版实例的ID，一定要和客户端实际使用的实例ID匹配。您可以在控制台实例详情页面的基础信息区域查看
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the returned results are displayed in reverse chronological order. Valid values:

true: The returned results are displayed in reverse order of the time when messages are delivered. This means that the latest consumed message is displayed as the first entry and the earliest consumed message is displayed as the last entry.

false: The returned results are displayed in order of the time when messages are delivered. This means that the earliest consumed message is displayed as the first entry and the latest consumed message is displayed as the last entry.

If you do not specify this parameter, the returned results are displayed in order of time when messages are delivered
parameters.help_zh:
返回结果是否倒序显示。取值说明如下：

true：按照消息的投递时间倒序显示，最后一条消费的消息显示在第一条，最早一条消费的消息显示在最后一条。

false：按照消息的投递时间顺序显示，最早一条消费的消息显示在第一条，最后一条消费的消息显示在最后一条。

若不输入，则返回结果默认按照消息的投递时间顺序显示
parameters.name: reverse

parameters.help_en: The ID of the client that subscribes to the message. If you do not specify this parameter, the IDs of all clients that subscribe to the message are returned
parameters.help_zh: 指定订阅消息的客户端ID。若不输入，则返回所有订阅该消息的客户端信息
parameters.name: client_id

parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range to query. The value of this parameter is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 查询范围的起始时间戳。单位：毫秒
parameters.name: begin_time

parameters.help_en: The end of the time range to query. The value of this parameter is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 查询范围的终止时间戳。单位：毫秒
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The number of the page to return. Pages start from page 1. If the input parameter value is greater than the total number of pages, the returned result is empty
parameters.help_zh: 当前取第几页消息，从1开始递增。若输入参数大于总页数，则返回结果为空
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. Valid values: 1 to 100
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询，每页最多显示的消息数量，最小1条，最多100条
parameters.name: page_size

CurrentPage.description_en: The page number of the returned page

MessageTraceLists.description_en: The delivery trace of the queried message
MessageTraceLists.description_zh: 返回的消息投递轨迹列表

Action.description_en:
The action on the message. Valid values:

sub: The ApsaraMQ for MQTT client subscribes to the message.

push_offline: The ApsaraMQ for MQTT broker pushes the offline message to the ApsaraMQ for MQTT client
Action.description_zh:
消息动作。取值说明如下：

sub：微消息队列MQTT版客户端订阅消息。

push_offline：服务端推送离线消息到微消息队列MQTT版客户端

ActionCode.description_en:
The code returned for the action on the message. Valid values:

mqtt.trace.action.msg.sub: The value that is returned if the value of Action is sub.

mqtt.trace.action.msg.push.offline: The value that is returned if the value of Action is push_offline
ActionCode.description_zh:
消息动作的返回码。取值说明如下：

mqtt.trace.action.msg.sub：消息动作取值为sub时返回该参数值。

mqtt.trace.action.msg.push.offline：消息动作取值为push_offline时返回该参数值

ActionInfo.description_en:
The returned information for the action on the message. Valid values:

Push To Mqtt Client: The value that is returned if the value of Action is sub.

Push Offline Msg To Mqtt Client: The value that is returned if the value of Action is push_offline
ActionInfo.description_zh:
消息动作的说明信息。取值说明如下：

Push To Mqtt Client：消息动作取值为sub时返回该参数值。

Push Offline Msg To Mqtt Client：消息动作取值为push_offline时返回该参数值

ClientId.description_en: The ID of the client that subscribes to the message

Time.description_en: The time when the message was delivered

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries returned per page
PageSize.description_zh: 每页最多显示的消息数量

RequestId.description_en: The unique ID that the system generates for the request. You can use the ID to troubleshoot issues. This parameter is a common parameter
RequestId.description_zh: 公共参数，每个请求的ID都是唯一的，可用于排查和定位问题

Total.description_zh: 查询到的消息轨迹总数
